messages:
Ava: Heads-up 1: we're adding a lightweight 'savings estimator' under the pricing calculator and want to test different tier label families + an FAQ quip explaining metered vs committed billing. Draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/pricing/savings-est-v1

Priyanka: Nice. Can we keep the estimator minimal? Ideally: input monthly tokens -> show estimated monthly cost + "estimated savings with commit" line. No surprises.

Leo: Agree. For tier names I prototyped three sets: Growth/Scale/Enterprise, Starter/Business/Enterprise, and Value/Performance/Enterprise. My bias: Growth/Scale reads well for product folks.

Gabe: We should map tier names to webinar scripts. If we land on Growth/Scale we can talk about "scale controls" in the demo. Also need to update inbound routing so high-savings projections hit SDR queue.

Ava: Good point Gabe. Priyanka 1, can you add a guardrail: if the estimator projects >$5k/month savings route to sales-intent queue. Otherwise default to marketing nurture.

Priyanka: Will do. Suggested event names: `prc_est_opened`, `prc_est_submitted`, `prc_est_savings_over_threshold`. Keep them short and prefixed `prc_` for pricing.

Leo: For the micro-FAQ text options I wrote three one-liners: (A) "Committed credits reduce your per-token rate; metered usage is billed monthly for overage." (B) "Committed plans get upfront discounts; usage beyond commitment is billed at the metered rate." (C) "Committed credits apply first; overages are invoiced monthly." Which reads best?

Gabe: A is clear. C is short but maybe too terse. Also add a small tooltip icon linking to a full FAQ for finance teams.

Ava: UX preference: show baseline price and a subtle line "See committed discounts" (click expands). Avoid showing big red savings numbers that might look like a guaranteed price.

Priyanka: Instrumentation snippet (client):
```
window.rwTrack('prc_est_submitted', { projected_savings: savings, variant: 'growth-scale' })
```

DeployBot: staging/pricing v2026.03.21-rc7 deployed by Priyanka 1 1ETA: 8m. :shipit:

Ava: For the A/B splits let's do: control (current calc) 50%, name-family A 25%, name-family B 25%. We'll run until 1,500 estimators submitted or 10 days.

Leo: I'll update webinar bullet points to reference whichever label family wins after the experiment. Also will prep two sentence blurb for launch post variants.

Gabe: Routing update: I'll add a rule to send leads with `prc_est_savings_over_threshold` + company email domain to SDR queue with tag "high-savings". Also adding a small playbook for SDRs so they don't oversell "guaranteed" pricing.

Priyanka: All instrumentation added to analytics repo. QA checklist in the doc.

Ava: Thanks — once we have enough samples we'll sync and pick tier names + final FAQ text for the docs and webinar script. If any of the variants drop calc completion by >7% we abort the variant and revert.
